This page contains an outline of the topics, content, and assignments for the semester. Note that this schedule will be updated as the semester progresses and the timeline of topics and assignments might be updated throughout the semester.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(googlesheets4)
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
gs4_deauth()
d <- read_sheet(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mMJwre7sE2RGyorwwn87cyBv6RY1woeV3pKeS_MoQz8/edit?gid=675503730#gid=675503730",
  sheet = "Schedule"
)
prepare_cutoff_date <- as.Date("2026-09-07")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| column: screen-right
d |>
  filter(!is.na(session)) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(as.Date(map_chr(date, as.character))), #modified this as date is a list of dttm variables
    readings = if_else(
      date > prepare_cutoff_date &
        (!(session == "-" & is.na(topic) & is.na(readings))),
      "_To be posted_",
      readings
    ),
    videos = if_else(
      date > prepare_cutoff_date &
        (!(session == "-" & is.na(topic) & is.na(videos))),
      "_To be posted_",
      videos
    ),
    #added the other & statements so that deadlines don't have "To be posted" language
    #readings = if_else(date > prepare_cutoff_date, "*To be posted*", readings) #added the other & statements so that deadlines don't have "To be posted" language
    # Materials column: one materials icon per lecture (file-lines) and lab
    # (file-code). Gray outline icon while unposted; filled + linked once a
    # URL is added to the sheet.
    materials = case_when(
      # In-class exams get no materials icon (review sessions keep theirs).
      str_detect(topic, "Exam.*In-class") ~ NA_character_,
      session == "Lec" & !is.na(materials) ~ paste0(
        '<a href="',
        materials,
        '" title="Lecture slides" aria-label="Lecture slides">',
        '<i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines materials-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>'
      ),
      session == "Lec" ~ paste0(
        '<i class="fa-regular fa-file-lines materials-icon-empty" ',
        'title="Slides to be posted" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
      ),
      session == "Lab" & !is.na(materials) ~ paste0(
        '<a href="',
        materials,
        '" title="Lab materials" aria-label="Lab materials">',
        '<i class="fa-solid fa-file-code materials-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>'
      ),
      session == "Lab" ~ paste0(
        '<i class="fa-regular fa-file-code materials-icon-empty" ',
        'title="Lab materials to be posted" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
      ),
      TRUE ~ materials
    ),
    # Prefix each reading entry with a FontAwesome book icon: green for r4ds,
    # blue for ims. Cells can hold several <br>-separated entries of mixed
    # sources, so prepend per entry rather than once per cell.
    readings = map_chr(readings, function(cell) {
      if (is.na(cell)) {
        return(cell)
      }
      str_split_1(cell, "<br>") |>
        map_chr(function(entry) {
          entry <- str_trim(entry)
          # don't decorate empty entries or the "To be posted" placeholder
          if (entry == "" || str_detect(entry, "To be posted")) {
            return(entry)
          }
          icon <- case_when(
            str_detect(
              entry,
              "\\[r4ds"
            ) ~ '<i class="fa-solid fa-book reading-icon-r4ds" aria-hidden="true"></i>',
            str_detect(
              entry,
              "\\[ims"
            ) ~ '<i class="fa-solid fa-book reading-icon-ims" aria-hidden="true"></i>',
            TRUE ~ '<i class="fa-solid fa-file reading-icon-other" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
          )
          str_c(icon, entry)
        }) |>
        str_c(collapse = "<br>")
    }),
    # Prefix each video entry with a FontAwesome icon: screwdriver-wrench
    # (yellow) for "Meet the toolkit", laptop-code for "Code along", else
    # chalkboard-user. Also strip the "... :: " label from the link text.
    videos = map_chr(videos, function(cell) {
      if (is.na(cell)) {
        return(cell)
      }
      str_split_1(cell, "<br>") |>
        map_chr(function(entry) {
          entry <- str_trim(entry)
          # don't decorate empty entries or the "To be posted" placeholder
          if (entry == "" || str_detect(entry, "To be posted")) {
            return(entry)
          }
          is_toolkit <- str_detect(
            entry,
            regex("Meet the toolkit :: ", ignore_case = TRUE)
          )
          is_codealong <- str_detect(
            entry,
            regex("Code along :: ", ignore_case = TRUE)
          )
          icon <- case_when(
            is_toolkit ~ '<i class="fa-solid fa-screwdriver-wrench video-icon-toolkit" aria-hidden="true"></i>',
            is_codealong ~ '<i class="fa-solid fa-laptop-code video-icon-codealong" aria-hidden="true"></i>',
            TRUE ~ '<i class="fa-solid fa-chalkboard-user video-icon-lecture" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
          )
          entry <- str_remove(
            entry,
            regex("Meet the toolkit :: ", ignore_case = TRUE)
          )
          entry <- str_remove(
            entry,
            regex("Code along :: ", ignore_case = TRUE)
          )
          str_c(icon, entry)
        }) |>
        str_c(collapse = "<br>")
    }),
  ) |>
  select(week, date, materials, topic, readings, videos, due) |> #moved this down so i can use session value in above mutate readings line
  # changed this to columns want to keep (instead of which to remove)
  relocate(due, .after = videos) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_date(date, date_style = 31) |>
  sub_missing(
    columns = c(week, readings, videos, topic, materials, due),
    missing_text = ""
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(week, materials)
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(date)
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(topic, readings, videos, due)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(
      color = "#b4b4b4"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = readings,
      rows = str_detect(readings, "To be posted")
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(
      color = "#b4b4b4"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = videos,
      rows = str_detect(videos, "To be posted")
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "right",
      color = "#D3D3D3",
      style = "solid"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = c(date, readings, videos, topic)
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    # add lines between weeks of the semester
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "top",
      color = "black",
      weight = px(2),
      style = "solid"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = everything(),
      rows = !is.na(week)
      # puts black line above rows where certain keywords are detected in certain columns
    )
  ) |>
  fmt_markdown(
    columns = c(topic, readings, videos, materials, due)
  ) |>
  tab_options(table.width = pct(98), table.align = 'left') |>
  cols_width(
    week ~ pct(2),
    date ~ pct(9),
    topic ~ pct(25),
    materials ~ pct(4),
    readings ~ pct(15),
    videos ~ pct(20),
    due ~ pct(15)
  ) |>
  cols_label_with(fn = function(x) {
    janitor::make_clean_names(x, case = "title") |>
      toupper() |>
      stringr::str_replace_all("^|$", "**") |>
      md()
  }) |>
  cols_label(materials = "") |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = 13) |>
  opt_row_striping()
```
